title: Advanced Engineer - Technology Development-Computer Vision
description:
Autoliv's primary goal is to Save More Lives. Our products never get a second chance. This is why we can never compromise on quality. We are working to increase vehicle safety by developing seatbelts, airbags and steering wheels and you can be part of our team as
**Senior Engineer / Advanced Engineer - Technology Development-Computer Vision**
**About The Role**
We are seeking a passionate and innovative
**Senior Engineer - Technology Development (Computer Vision)**
to develop next-generation perception technologies that enable advanced 3D understanding, localization, mapping, and scene interpretation. This role combines cutting-edge research with practical engineering to create scalable, production-ready computer vision solutions using monocular and stereo imaging systems.
  
  
You will work on challenging problems involving computer vision, multi-view geometry, sensor calibration, SLAM/VINS, deep learning, and 3D reconstruction while collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to bring innovative technologies into real-world applications.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Design, develop, and optimize computer vision solutions using monocular and stereo camera systems.
* Build and validate 3D localization, mapping, SLAM (Simultaneous Localization and Mapping), and VINS (Visual Inertial Navigation System) pipelines.
* Develop algorithms for:

+ 3D reconstruction
+ Multi-view geometry
+ Depth estimation
+ Camera pose estimation
+ Scene understanding

* Perform camera modeling and calibration for pinhole, fisheye, and stereo vision systems.
* Apply both classical computer vision techniques and deep learning-based approaches for perception applications.
* Develop data preprocessing, feature engineering, and model evaluation pipelines.
* Implement and optimize solutions using Python, C++, OpenCV, and Point Cloud Library (PCL).
* Deploy, monitor, and improve AI/ML solutions on Linux-based systems and cloud platforms such as Azure ML Studio.
* Analyze performance bottlenecks, debug issues, and continuously improve solution robustness and accuracy.
* Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to translate research concepts into scalable products.

What You'll Be Working On
  
  

* Advanced Computer Vision Systems
* Stereo & Monocular Perception
* 3D Localization & Mapping
* Visual SLAM / VINS
* Depth Estimation Models
* Human Pose Estimation
* Object Detection Systems
* Camera Calibration & Sensor Fusion
* Cloud-Based AI/ML Deployment
* Next-Generation Perception Technologies

**Required Technical Skills**
Computer Vision & 3D Perception
  
  

* Monocular and Stereo Vision Systems
* Multi-view Geometry
* Camera Calibration
* 3D Reconstruction
* Depth Estimation
* Scene Understanding
* Visual Localization
* Human Pose Estimation

Machine Learning & Deep Learning
  
  

* CNN-based Object Detection
* Depth Estimation Networks
* Human Pose Estimation Models
* Model Evaluation & Validation
* Data Annotation and Dataset Development

Programming & Tools
  
  

* Python
* C++
* OpenCV
* Point Cloud Library (PCL)
* NumPy
* Pandas
* Linux Development Environment

Cloud & Deployment
  
  

* Azure ML Studio
* Cloud-based ML Workflows
* Model Deployment and Monitoring

**Preferred Experience**
We are looking for candidates with hands-on experience in:
  
  

* Developing computer vision applications for real-world deployment.
* Building and deploying SLAM, VINS, or localization systems.
* Camera calibration and stereo vision pipeline development.
* 3D mapping and reconstruction technologies.
* Working with deep learning models such as:

+ Depth Anything
+ OpenPose
+ Object Detection Frameworks

* End-to-end AI/ML model development and deployment on cloud platforms.

Behavioral Competencies
  
  

* Customer Focus
* Global Perspective
* Innovation Mindset
* Sound Decision Making
* Execution Excellence
* Accountability
* Collaboration & Teamwork
* Leadership and Influence
* People Development
* Trust Building

We will be more than glad to chat with you about your experience and your career goals.
  
  
In our international work setting, you will find a range of opportunities that are designed to enhance your career and personal development. Including new and different perspectives is part of what ensures the team’s success. We are committed to develop people’s skills, knowledge and creative potential. Our training and development programs emphasize technical competency, leadership development and business management skill.
  
  
**More lives saved – more life lived!**
